lines: Slice one point two gives Christian Fitness its backend, closed until you sign in.
Five projects, one direction. Domain holds the entities, Application the rules and the seeds, Infrastructure speaks to Postgres, and the API and the command line sit on top.
Health answers anyone, in one word. Live means the process runs; ready means the database answers.
Here there is none, so it says unhealthy, and nothing more.

lines.text: Everything else needs a session. Without one, the answer is a four oh one, as Problem Details with a code the screens can branch on, even for a path that doesn't exist.
lines.caption: Everything else needs a session. Without one, the answer is a 401, as ProblemDetails with a code the screens can branch on, even for a path that doesn't exist.

lines.text: An unexpected error becomes a plain five hundred, code server error: no message, no stack trace.
lines.caption: An unexpected error becomes a plain 500, code server_error: no message, no stack trace.

lines: Open Telemetry records each request by its route template, method and status.
The path, the query string and anything personal are dropped before export.

lines.text: The API never migrates. C F migrate applies the schema, and C F seed adds the first admin from settings. Run it twice, and nothing changes.

lines: Every rule failed first, then passed: twenty-one tests, and no real database.
That's slice one point two. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
